items.question: Can BAMS graduates write NEET-PG for MD seats?

row.judgeReason: Fails to directly answer the core question (whether BAMS graduates can write NEET-PG, which is strictly for MBBS graduates) and deflects with system meta-language.

raw.answer: The sources available to me don't cover NEET-PG eligibility rules yet — a mentor will confirm. However, as an Ayurveda intern, your official pathway to Post Graduate (MD/MS) courses in the Ayurveda medical stream is through the AIAPGET examination, which is linked with NTA on the official Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee (AACCC) 2026 portal [c:ced167f0756b13afc6c64a860c0d135365bb1b59]. While NEET (UG) is the qualifying exam used for undergraduate BAMS admissions, PG aspirants in Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani, and Homoeopathy (ASU&H) qualify through AIAPGET [c:f339c0fa977417d9f3e9533b282bdc3b77ba046a, c:a0a25696c2d8e8093ca0184ad7ac89a10555429d]. Once you qualify in AIAPGET, AACCC under NCISM conducts online counseling for the allotment of All India Quota (AIQ) PG (MD/MS) seats [c:ced167f0756b13afc6c64a860c0d135365bb1b59, c:f339c0fa977417d9f3e9533b282bdc3b77ba046a]. According to the 2026 AACCC information, this includes 15% AIQ PG seats in Government and Government-aided ASU&H institutes across states and union territories, 100% PG seats in Deemed Universities established under the Central Act, 100% National Institutes seats (except state, institutional, or nominated seats where applicable), and 100% PG seats (AIQ plus Institutional Quota) under Banaras Hindu University [c:f339c0fa977417d9f3e9533b282bdc3b77ba046a]. Because admission rules and schedules are updated every year, please confirm the latest eligibility criteria and exam notices directly on the official AACCC and NTA websites.
actions: Check the official AACCC portal and follow the AIAPGET-NTA link for the current PG entrance information bulletin.
Read the Schedule and Information Bulletin for AACCC PG on the official website to understand the seat allotment process.
Review the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (National Examinations for Indian System of Medicine) Regulations, 2023.
raw.mistake: Confusing undergraduate NEET (UG) or other medical entrance exams with AIAPGET, which is the designated entrance test for AYUSH PG counseling.

items.question: Is NEET PG compulsory for MD Ayurveda or is AIAPGET enough?

row.judgeReason: Contains internal AI meta-language ('the sources available to me don't cover NEET-PG details yet — a mentor will confirm') and presents unsupported specific guidelines.

raw.answer: As a BAMS intern planning for your post-graduation, you need to appear for the All India Ayush Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET), which is linked with the National Testing Agency (NTA) on the 2026 AACCC portal [c:ced167f0756b13afc6c64a860c0d135365bb1b59][c:f30f33ff0cf8e89e62f7f3b48f8bcb67791b5aa9]. You do not take NEET-PG; the sources available to me don't cover NEET-PG details yet — a mentor will confirm. According to the 2026 Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee (AACCC) notices, AIAPGET is the qualifying entrance test for Post Graduate (MD/MS) aspirants in Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani, and Homoeopathy streams [c:ced167f0756b13afc6c64a860c0d135365bb1b59][c:f339c0fa977417d9f3e9533b282bdc3b77ba046a]. Once you qualify in AIAPGET, AACCC under NCISM conducts online PG counselling for 15% All India Quota seats in government and government-aided institutes across states and union territories, 100% PG seats in Deemed Universities, 100% seats in National Institutes (excluding specific state, institutional, or nominated seats), and 100% All India and Institutional Quota PG seats at Banaras Hindu University [c:ced167f0756b13afc6c64a860c0d135365bb1b59][c:f339c0fa977417d9f3e9533b282bdc3b77ba046a]. Note that under the Ministry of Ayush 2023-24 Central Government Nomination guidelines, eligible regular government teachers, medical officers, and research officers nominated against reserved Central Pool seats are not subjected to AIAPGET, though unavailed vacant seats revert to AIAPGET-qualified candidates via AACCC counselling [c:f30f33ff0cf8e89e62f7f3b48f8bcb67791b5aa9]. Because admissions and exam rules change every year, please confirm the latest eligibility criteria and dates on the official NTA and AACCC portals.

Check the official AIAPGET-NTA portal for the current year's exam syllabus and application schedule.

items.question: Are there contract jobs for BAMS doctors under the National AYUSH Mission?

row.judgeReason: Contains an unsupported core claim regarding UG AYUSH doctor roles at Community Health Centres under NAM guidelines.

raw.answer: According to the 2023 National AYUSH Mission (NAM) Operational Guidelines, there are roles for an AYUSH doctor with a UG qualification at Community Health Centres (CHCs), while District Hospitals (DHs) require an AYUSH doctor with a PG qualification [c:334a2ce05515b2eb004a56d941d3f125734df543, c:c9a29c07d06bcb2afd6a3fb632d3bc394b9a5d40]. At the CHC level, your responsibilities as a UG doctor include opportunistic screening, health promotion, managing identified conditions, treating Non-Communicable Disease (NCD) complications with AYUSH medicine as an adjuvant, and overall supervision of the NCD Unit [c:334a2ce05515b2eb004a56d941d3f125734df543]. You also monitor the Lifestyle Clinic, compile data from CHCs and PHCs, and help identify Yoga volunteers [c:334a2ce05515b2eb004a56d941d3f125734df543]. Separately, the Ministry of Ayush also engages Young Professionals and Consultants on a contract basis [c:78d0e7e69132dcf479bcfa706a99380ab9f1e28f, c:53f20946956cf31b76b4554a1c7cac0a83939e8c]. However, regarding the exact contractual recruitment terms, salary, and application procedures for BAMS doctors under NAM, the sources available to me don't cover this yet — a mentor will confirm. Note that NAM is a mission scheme, unlike regular state PSC or central UPSC recruitment, and rules differ by state and change every year. Always verify the latest notifications on your state AYUSH department or official commission website.
actions: Read the National AYUSH Mission Operational Guidelines to understand the clinical duties of a UG AYUSH doctor at a CHC.
Complete your internship and keep your state board registration and academic records ready for upcoming recruitment notifications.
Check the Ministry of Ayush and your state AYUSH department portals regularly for official recruitment notifications and eligibility rules.
raw.mistake: Applying for District Hospital AYUSH doctor roles under NAM with only a UG degree when the guidelines specify a PG qualification for those posts.
